# SasaVenos Uses The Example Of Jan And Alessio To Show Individualization For Planche Training

SasaVenos uses the example of Jan and Alessio learning advanced tuck planche to show that individualization is needed because different people have different limitations. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]

## Details

- Jan simply does not understand the activations and lacks some strength, so he does holds with light bands with good activations, builds more volume over time and works on his shoulder strength. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- Alessio had a car crash that rearranged his radial bone, limiting his range of motion, so he has to train planche with semi-supination from the start. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- Alessio also has hyperflexion in the elbows, so he focuses mostly on strengthening the elbows with a variety of exercises, leans, tuck holds and dumbbells. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]

## Evidence

- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "Jan simply doesn't understand the activations and lacks some strength, but he's not doing too bad."
- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "Jan is simply going to do holds with light bands with good activations, build more volume over time and work on his shoulder strength, as he did and he got better quite quickly."
- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "Alessio has had a car crash where he uncomfortably rearranged his radial bone, which is now limiting the range of motion of his radial deviation."
- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "Alessio is going to have to train planche with semi-supination from the start."
- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "Alessio also has hyperflexion in the elbows."
- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "He will focus mostly on strengthening the elbows with a variety of exercises, leans, tuck holds and dumbbells, so he doesn't die from boredom."
